verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a registry and CLI for installing skills into external agents. A built-in assistant is a plausible feature for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party AI assistant to which users can delegate tasks. `skills use --agent` only launches a third-party coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) with a generated prompt. That is an external tool's capability, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit.
